overview: The Charter Study Committee refined charter provisions regarding appointments, approved draft preamble language, and established the proposed size and makeup of the City Council. The committee voted to recommend an 11-member City Council consisting of eight ward councilors and three at large.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee accepted the meeting minutes from December.

items.title: Preamble Language
items.summary: Approved revised wording for the charter preamble after amending phrases regarding Medford's history and commitments.

items.title: City Council Confirmation and Appointment Powers
items.summary: Approved provisional language granting the City Council authority to reject mayoral appointments to multi-member boards by a two-thirds vote, while referring department head confirmations back to subcommittee and removing council authority to overturn mayoral removals.

items.title: City Council Size and Composition
items.summary: Approved a recommendation for an 11-member City Council composed of eight ward representatives and three at-large councilors.

items.title: School Committee Subcommittee and Term Length Discussion
items.summary: Paulette Van der Kloot reported on discussions with the school superintendent regarding the operational benefits of four-year terms, and the subcommittee set its next meeting for January 23.

items.title: Listening Sessions and Public Engagement Updates
items.summary: Members reviewed the calendar of upcoming public listening sessions, planned for a January 25 information session at City Hall, and discussed tracking committee dates and pushing the public charter survey.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Resident Paul Garrity asked about potential ward structure for the School Committee and inquired whether a town manager structure remains under consideration.
